description.value:
Trigger an ally in range finishes casting a spell of 5th rank or lower

The spell happens again immediately, targeting whatever the original caster chooses, using their statistics. You are not casting it. You are repeating it.

cinderfall.incomplete: No rule element re-triggers or duplicates a triggering spellcast using another actor's statistics — confirmed absent across the full 34-key inventory (P12; no "reflect"/"echo"/duplicate-cast key exists, verified via `grep -rli "reflect" pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/*.ts` → 0 hits). This is bucket 4 in spirit (a cross-creature effect keyed off a third party's own action) even though the trigger source is a reaction rather than a passive.
